outcome: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder requiring postpartum hysterectomy
cohort: 64 women who underwent postpartum hysterectomy for PAS and 192 matched controls who had a previous cesarean
finding: Previous uterine surgery, a higher number of previous cesareans, smoking, and an interdelivery interval of fewer than 18 months after a cesarean were identified as significant risk factors for PAS requiring postpartum hysterectomy.
